project_meta.name: Cyberboss
project_meta.description: WeChat Agent Bridge for Personal Life Operations - 接入微信的本地生活 Agent Bridge
tech_stack: Codex / Claude Code (可切换运行时)
project_meta.architecture: Event-Driven Bridge Pattern with Pluggable Adapters
project_meta.core_paradigm: 围绕事件流、会话线程、流式交付、任务队列构建的实时多源聚合系统

core_directory_map.src/core/: 系统核心骨架 - 配置、应用启动、流传递、线程状态、消息分发
core_directory_map.src/adapters/: 通道适配层 - runtime(Codex/Claude)和channel(WeChat)的双向协议翻译
core_directory_map.src/services/: 业务服务层 - 日记、提醒、时间轴、贴纸、愿景处理
core_directory_map.src/tools/: Agent工具暴露层 - MCP服务端、项目工具定义、运行时上下文
core_directory_map.src/app/: 应用协程 - 系统检查轮询、生命周期控制

bootstrap: src/index.js: 环境加载 -> 配置读取 -> bootstrap文件初始化
readConfig(): 三层级环境变量加载(项目.env -> ~/.cyberboss/.env -> shell)
primary_inbound_flow: buildInboundDraft() -> 消息规范化、附件分类、视觉内容处理
StreamDelivery.handleRuntimeEvent() -> 事件队列分配回复目标
assembleRuntimeTurnText() -> 格式化为runtime输入(时间戳+上文+附件+视觉描述)
Runtime.request(threadId, turnText) -> 流式回复处理
primary_outbound_flow: sendTextWithRetry() -> 微信发送+自动重试+context_token刷新

critical_components.name: CyberbossApp
critical_components.responsibility: 应用生命周期、初始化所有adapters/services、事件分发枢纽、登录/启动/诊断入口
key_methods: start() // 启动WebSocket/HTTP服务、初始化微信长轮询、启动系统checkin定时器
onWeixinInbound(message) // 微信入站消息处理、转换为runtime turn
handleRuntimeEvent(event) // 运行时流式回复、提醒、系统消息分发
printDoctor() // 配置诊断、线程状态快照

critical_components.name: StreamDelivery
critical_components.responsibility: 运行时事件流->微信文本转换、stream去重聚合、retry/defer机制、context_token刷新
key_methods: handleRuntimeEvent(event) // 根据事件类型(turn.started/reply.delta/reply.completed)更新状态
flush(state, {force}) // 强制或按需发送pending deliveries
sendTextWithRetry(payload) // 一次重试+context_token刷新+defer fallback
resolveSystemReplyDelivery(text, policy) // 区分silent/send_message/invalid

critical_components.name: ProjectToolHost
critical_components.responsibility: Agent工具枚举、调用分发、schema验证、上下文解析
key_methods: listTools() // 返回PROJECT_TOOLS + WhereaboutsToolHost工具
invokeTool(toolName, args, context) // schema校验+handler分发+错误处理
resolveContext(context) // 从runtimeContextStore推导workspace/thread/account

critical_components.name: ChannelAdapter(WeChat)
critical_components.responsibility: 微信API HTTP协议、长轮询同步、登录管理、消息收发、context_token维护
key_methods: onInbound() // 长轮询拉取消息、并发限制、sync-buffer管理
sendText(payload) // POST /message/send、错误分类、ret=-2检测
getKnownContextTokens() // 返回userId->contextToken映射

critical_components.name: RuntimeAdapter(Codex/Claude)
critical_components.responsibility: 本地runtime命令行启动、WebSocket/pipe协议通信、事件流式接收、turn隔离
key_methods: spawnRuntime(config) // 启动private runtime或连接shared app-server
onRuntimeEvent(event) // 监听runtime.turn.started/.reply.delta/.reply.completed/.turn.failed
request(threadId, text) // 发送turn请求、返回Promise

critical_components.name: SystemCheckinPoller
critical_components.responsibility: 随机轮询唤醒触发、Checkin间隔管理、可调整频率
key_methods: runSystemCheckinPoller() // 按配置间隔触发system消息队列
randomCheckinTrigger() // 生成随机checkin事件

critical_components.name: ReminderService
critical_components.responsibility: 提醒队列持久化、时间计算(相对/绝对)、发送者解析
key_methods: create({text, delayMinutes, dueAt}) // 验证时间+发送者+context_token->入队
resolveDueAtMs() // 支持delay字符串(1h30m)、ISO8601、分钟数

critical_components.name: TimelineService
critical_components.responsibility: 与timeline-for-agent交互、事件写入、截图生成
key_methods: write(args) // 转发timeline-for-agent API、事件日期/分类/tag管理
captureScreenshot(args) // 调用Chrome/Edge headless、指定selector和范围

critical_components.name: StickerService
critical_components.responsibility: 表情包GIF入库、标签索引、图片规范化、去重
key_methods: saveFromInbox(items, context) // 转换格式为GIF、写入tags.json、去重检测
pick(tag, limit) // 标签检索、返回候选stickerId列表

critical_components.name: ThreadStateStore
critical_components.responsibility: 线程元数据持久化、binding(workspaceRoot+accountId+threadId)、模型/权限状态
key_methods: save(threadId, state) // 写入sessions.json
findBindingForThreadId(threadId) // workspace->thread映射

global_state: runtimeContextStore: {runtimeId, workspaceRoot, threadId, accountId} (MCP调用上下文)
db_schemas: sessions.json: [{workspaceRoot, workspaceId, threadId, accountId, runtimeId, model, ...}]
reminder-queue.json: [{id, accountId, senderId, contextToken, text, dueAtMs, ...}]

potential_weaknesses: StreamDelivery中markdown转plain_text的正则简陋，复杂格式可能误转换
context_token刷新机制依赖ChannelAdapter.getKnownContextTokens()，若微信侧token过期可能retry失败
无全局锁保护并发turn处理，多个threadId同时请求时replyTargetQueue可能竞态
WeChat LongPoll无背压控制，高流量时sync-buffer可能堆积
RuntimeAdapter与runtime进程通信缺少heartbeat，僵尸进程无自动恢复
ReminderService的dueAtMs > Date.now()校验未考虑系统时钟跳变
StickerService的GIF规范化依赖外部脚本(scripts/normalize-sticker-gif.js)，失败处理不完整
TimelineService.captureScreenshot()的Chrome/Chromium启动路径硬编码，跨平台适配不足
buildMergedInboundPrepared()中multi-message合并无序列号保证，可能乱序
缺少explicit error boundary和graceful shutdown，某个adapter崩溃可能导致全流程中断
Session文件并发写入无原子操作，高频修改可能corruption
MCP工具的accessControl没有per-workspace权限隔离，仅依赖context推导
缺少内存泄漏防御：stateByRunKey.delete()依赖主动调用，流异常中断时状态无清理
TODO: Codex adapter协议泄露检测(sanitizeProtocolLeakText)仅过滤已知pattern，新型泄露无防护
